queryBoundary: west/south inclusive, east/north exclusive; outer grid posts retained for interpolation
verticalRule: USGS compound conversion then H96=h-N96; Cesium uses h=H96+N96 exactly once from canonical grid
normalization: Native float32 DEM pixel-center bilinear sampling; inverse/forward registered NAD83+NAVD88 -> WGS84 height iteration onto fixed WGS84 posts; H96=h-N96
dtedQuantization: nearest integer meter, ties to even; DTED signed magnitude
cesiumLayout: little-endian float32, rows north to south, columns west to east; geographic posts
amaseSupportedHeights: nonnegative for current formal DTED reader; negative input explicitly refused
sourceSelection: Fixed west-before-east USGS tile priority in shared padding; no averaging or NoData fallback
